title: W3Schools: Dictionary Safe Get
description: Given dictionary `d`, a search `key`, and a `default_val`, return the value of `key` if present, else return `default_val`.
starter_code:
def get_dict_value(d: dict, key: str, default_val: str) -> str:
    pass
solution:
def get_dict_value(d: dict, key: str, default_val: str) -> str:
    return d.get(key, default_val)
explanation: Dict get() performs safe O(1) key lookup with fallback.
